name: returns a full order that respects branching prerequisites
input: four tasks with one shared prerequisite
test:
dependencies = [(1, 0), (2, 1), (3, 0)]
order = find_installation_order(4, dependencies)
assert sorted(order) == [0, 1, 2, 3]
position = {task: index for index, task in enumerate(order)}
assert all(position[prerequisite] < position[task] for task, prerequisite in dependencies)
